title: Prayer Alarm
description:
Introducing the Prayer Alarm app - your personal assistant for keeping track of daily Salat times. With our app, you can set customized alarms for each salat, ensuring you never miss a prayer again. The app lets you set custom alarms for any time, making it an everyday tool for life. With an effective ‘Quiet’ mode, you can specify times to keep your phone silent to perform prayers uninterrupted. Apart from that, get precise timings for sunrise, sunset, and learn about the forbidden times to offer Salat. Download the Prayer Alarm app now and stay on track with your daily prayers.

App feature highlights:

Customized alarm for Salat: Most apps are built-in with default Salat times and alarms, but our Prayer Alarm is customizable. You can set your preferred time for alarm based on Salat times accordingly. Moreover, you can use it as your default alarm app to wake you up in the morning and schedule routines based on Salat times.

Create schedules based on Salat times: Our app lets you set your work schedule in a time that does not overlap with a Salat time. The scheduling process is made easy with intuitive setting options.

Dynamic Reminder List: The app features a comprehensive Reminder functionality that allows you to create specific and detailed reminder lists to keep all your regular schedules in check.

Quiet mode: The 'Quiet' mode lets you specify periods when your phone will remain silent, providing a peaceful environment for uninterrupted prayer.

Gregorian and Hijri dates: Both gregorian and hijri dates are equally important in your daily lives. This app will help you keep track of both dates simultaneously. 

In addition, the app also features daytime, sunrise, sunset, zawal time, and forbidden times to offer Salat.
